The Lao Five

New signatures, deep Laos

  • Khaen Fire140,000

    Tequila, mak khaen tincture, smoke under a cloche, lifted at your table. Mezcal upgrade +40,000.

  • Tam Mak Muang140,000

    Lao gin, green mango and dill cordial, lime, chili-lime salt. Carbonated in the bottle.

  • Night Market140,000

    Black-sesame bourbon, Lao brown rum, roselle cordial, five-spice palm sugar. Brittle shard standing in the ice.

  • Mekong Shore140,000

    Laodi white and ginger rums, mak kok shrub, young coconut water, lime. Kaipen to eat between sips.

  • Plain of JarsInstagram195,000

    Xieng Khuang plum rum, Bolaven cold-brew tea, mulberry, lime, egg white. Served in its own little clay jar.
